nodes.description: Private owner address; privileged role for _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping used by transferFrom and approve.
Whitelisted trade address settable only by owner and checked in ensure.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure.
Mapping of addresses allowed to sell without condition checks; set in _mints.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and compared in condition.
Global sale cap configured by init and read in condition.
Minimum sale amount configured by init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount configured by init and enforced in condition.
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as _from.
Public payable transferFrom; checks allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal whitelist gate; allows owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale or condition-passing senders.
Internal sale-limit check using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address.
Privileged mint function that sets balanceOf[spender] and marks canSale[spender]; authorization uses a hardcoded address literal.
Owner-only configuration of _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length and loops over recipients.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap pair address for a token pair via CREATE2 formula.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, supply, owner, initial balance and unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, token source and owner assignment.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address supplied by the owner, allowing arbitrary code execution in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath, permitting underflow/overflow.
total = _value * _tos.length computed with plain multiplication, allowing overflow of the batch total.
Parameter _value of transferFrom: amount transferred and compared against allowances and balance.
Parameter _from of transferFrom: source address whose allowance/balance/state is used.
Parameter _to of transferFrom: recipient address credited with the tokens.
Parameters spender and addedValue of _mints used to set balance and canSale.
Local variable total in batchSend accumulating _value * _tos.length.
Loop index i in batchSend iterating over the recipient array.
Parameter _tos of batchSend: caller-supplied array of recipient addresses.
Local _UNI in ensure holding the computed pairFor address used in the whitelist check.
Parameters saleNum, token and maxToken of init used to derive _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as _from in transferFrom and drives the allowance authorization branch.
_mints requires msg.sender to equal owner or a hardcoded address literal.
init requires msg.sender == owner before configuring sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before changing the whitelist address.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
owner is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor.
delegate passes the caller-supplied address and bytes into an unchecked low-level delegatecall.
The delegatecall executes arbitrary external code that can call back into transferFrom using the contract's own storage context.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
transferFrom calls ensure to gate the transfer through whitelist/sale conditions.
ensure falls back to condition for non-whitelisted senders.
owner is compared against _from/_to in the ensure whitelist.
Constant UNI router address is whitelisted in ensure.
canSale[_from] whitelist flag short-circuits ensure.
pairFor output _UNI is compared with _from inside ensure.
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum inside condition.
_saleNum gates early return inside condition.
_minSale is compared against the transfer value inside condition.
_maxSale is compared against the transfer value inside condition.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are read and written with unchecked -= and += operations.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf subtractions and additions without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each successful transfer.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true.
_mints writes balanceOf[spender] based on addedValue and decimals.
init assigns the saleNum parameter to _saleNum.
init assigns the token parameter to _minSale.
init assigns the maxToken parameter to _maxSale.
setTradeAddress writes the caller-supplied addr into tradeAddress.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] and increments balanceOf[_to] in a loop.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor computes and assigns totalSupply.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
init parameters saleNum, token and maxToken feed the sale limit configuration.
The _tos array parameter provides recipients and its length for batchSend arithmetic.
Loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend.
Local total holds the unchecked product used in batchSend.
_mints parameters spender and addedValue drive balance and canSale writes.
Parameter _value of transferFrom is the amount validated and moved.
Parameter _from of transferFrom is the account whose allowance, balance and state are used.
Parameter _to of transferFrom is the credited recipient.
Local _UNI computed by pairFor is used in the ensure whitelist comparison.

normalization_plan.reason: _value is exclusively consumed by transferFrom for allowance and balance arithmetic.
_from is exclusively consumed by transferFrom for allowance, whitelist and balance state.
_to is exclusively consumed by transferFrom as the credited recipient.
spender and addedValue only feed the balance and canSale writes inside _mints.
total exists only to hold the unchecked multiplication result inside batchSend.
Loop index i is a purely local iteration counter of batchSend.
_tos is only used as the recipient array and length operand inside batchSend.
_UNI is computed and consumed solely within the ensure whitelist check.
saleNum, token and maxToken only parameterize the init configuration writes.
